pass: Completion Pass 7: Source Installation Control Verification & Final Interaction Closure

methodology.rootCause: In Pass 6, tests/browser/installation-clearance.capture.ts blindly dispatched the first control tuple (controls[0]) for each installation. For 8 installations, controls[0] maps to either a lower-clamped navigation key (ArrowLeft at index 0) or an idempotent mode/query selector key (Digit1 when index 0 is already active). Re-selecting the active index produced an identical state, causing beforeState === afterState (stateChanged: false).
adjudicationProof: Deterministic unit test tests/installation-controls.test.ts verifies both that controls[0] is idempotent on initial state and that the authored progression/action key mutates state and updates status text.

Playwright end-to-end browser capture tests/browser/installation-clearance.capture.ts verifies live interaction, focus acquisition, engaged status, and stateChanged: true across all 13 wing installations.
